source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical MIME adapter returns Some(false) for is_read with a TODO to read X-Mozilla-Status, while its save request always adds MSGFLAG_READ. The relocated accepted adapter still reports false, but current CreateMessage has an explicit is_read argument and independent unresolved MAPI flags. Do not assume these sources agree or use the TODO as evidence of an implemented status parser. This is a narrow historical/current static state mismatch with no active-call or runtime failure claim.
title: Keep read state from parsed headers distinct from saved-message server flags
